denied.title: Author management is unavailable
denied.description: This page is open to the admin role only. Editors can credit existing authors on posts.

validation.slugUnavailable: No slug could be generated; enter one manually.
validation.slugInvalid: Slug may contain only lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens.

errors.stale: The author changed after you opened the page. Reload the page and apply your change again.
errors.accountTaken: This account is already linked to another author.
errors.slugTaken: This slug is already in use or redirects from an old address.
errors.inactiveAccount: Only the account of an active editorial member can be linked.
errors.credited: This author is credited on posts. Remove the credits in the post editor before deleting.
errors.avatarRejected: The uploaded image was not accepted. Try again with another image.

form.name: Name
form.slugPlaceholder: Generated from the name if left empty
form.slugHintEdit: If the slug changes, the old author address redirects to the new one.
form.bioHint: Optional. Shown on the author page and in search results.
form.accountHint: Only editorial members can be linked. A link grants no permissions; editing rights come from the membership role.

list.title: Authors
list.intro: Author identities shown on posts. Guest authors have no account; an identity can be linked to an editorial member.
list.listDescription: Credit counts include drafts. An author page is visible only when the author is credited on a published post.
list.newDescription: The slug must be unique; names may repeat.

author.credits: Credited on {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}
author.avatarDescription: Shown in bylines and on the author archive. It is independent of the linked account’s profile picture; the old photo is deleted when it is replaced or removed.
author.deleteCredited: This author is credited on {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}. Remove the credits in the post editor before deleting.
author.deleteUncredited: This author is not credited on any post. Once deleted, the old author addresses return 404.
author.confirm: I understand that the author “{name}” will be deleted.
